system.text:
Look: late-night cinema.

Ground #0F0E13 · surfaces #1A1820 / #24212C · text #F4F1EA / #ABA5B6.
Accent: marquee amber #F5B83D (Want, primary actions).
Type badges: Film amber, TV sky #7CC4FF, Anime pink #FF9BC2 — always labelled, never colour alone.

Type: Bricolage Grotesque (display) + Instrument Sans (body).

Gestures: swipe right = Want to watch, left = Pass, up = Seen it (opens rating). Every gesture has a button twin.

Artwork, synopsis, cast and trailer come live from TMDB (film/TV) and AniList (anime).

phase2.text:
Phase 2 rules.

Streaming: services are stored as one name each (Netflix, never ‘Netflix Standard with Ads’). Off: titles on your services are lifted. ‘Only what I can stream’: everything else is hidden; a title whose availability isn’t known yet stays until its details load.

Filters: length and decade last for the session, like the Films/TV/Anime pills. The filter button wears an amber dot while any are on; a summary line with Clear sits under the pills.

People: tap anyone in a cast row, the crew line, or Taste. Their work is ranked for you; lead roles rank above cameos.

Not this franchise: offered on the Pass toast and in detail when a title belongs to a series (a TMDB collection, or related anime). Undo lives on Taste → Never show me.

New seasons: TV you’ve watched whose next season premieres after your last diary entry. Logging it clears the alert; ✕ dismisses it. The Library tab wears a dot.

Taste over time: one row per genre on one shared scale, the current month as the amber dot. Trends are named in words, never colour alone; tap a row for its numbers.
